'''catman421 Set Your Course . . . To Victory (SYCFA) (V2)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 2 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 SYCFA catman421 DS 2003 SetYourC.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Second version.  Simple SYCFA deck that uses Star Destroyers packing big guns.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Get the death star to Alderaan and destroy it as quickly as possible (hopefully by turn 4).  Then I start playing Star Destroyers.  Motti (V) boosts power.  Along with fighter cover, star destroyers armed with weapons are power +8, otherwise +2.

After I destroy Alderaan, I attack Yavin.  Once I destroy Yavin, I play A Day Long Remembered.  All Rebel characters and starships are deploy +8.  Star destroyers can force drain and battle.  R3-T6 @ Central Core boosts the star's hyperspeed.  Jade, Maul, P-59 and P-60 go around destroying ground forces.  The admirals boost the effectiveness of star destroyers and grab one AO.  Tarkin (V), Palpatine and Vader provide protection to the death star.  FWKTIL (V) deals direct damage to my opponent.  ADITF (V) Allows for retrieval.  SMOK allows for more retrieval.  Imp. Reinforcements provides specific retrieval (starships and imps), FL kills characters where Palpatine is and LR deals more damage.

Thanks to LordHoban, Rickynumber24 and Blackmoon for the suggestions on V1.
